rv.q: Walking out of the show, one feels a little closer to whatever cure will work on this sick world.
And THE LOWER DEPTHS, as adapted by Grayson Kennedy for Gwydion Theatre Company, certainly did that.
The Lower Depths continues Gwydion’s season-long exploration of class issues, which began with last fall’s Death of a Salesman by Arthur Miller.

cn.t: Gwydion Theatre's adaptation of Gorky's 1902 classic provokes thought and stirs emotion, though execution proves uneven. A challenging, discussion-worthy production that hits hard thematically but doesn't fully satisfy all critics.
